params.name: ply

params.name: sheet

params.name: kerf
params.comment: the beam, the full width the laser takes out

params.name: slot_tighten
params.comment: how much narrower the mortices are drawn than the sheet

params.name: cheek_past
params.comment: read only: the narrow cheek's rim past each wall's centreline, as cut: the line is drawn on its mortices' edge, and the beam takes half a kerf inside it

params.name: tooth

params.name: shoulder
params.comment: the least of a panel left past its end teeth

params.name: play
params.comment: each mortice's play a side along its tooth

params.name: mortice_w
params.comment: read only: a mortice along its wall, as cut

params.name: mortice_h
params.comment: read only: a mortice either side of its wall's centreline, as cut

params.name: wall_off
params.comment: read only: each wall's centreline from the bore's

params.name: cheek_off
params.comment: read only: each cheek's rim from the bore's centreline
